title: HIM 103 - Health Statistics, Registers and Report Writing

items.q: Data quality audit may be defined as
o: the documented trail showing who held a record at each stage
a check of records against agreed standards to find and correct defects
the delivery of a child that shows signs of life after separation
a system that waits for hospitals to send in their own cases
items.s: Data quality audit: a check of records against agreed standards to find and correct defects. The other options describe Live birth, Passive registration, Chain of custody.

items.q: Completeness may be defined as
o: a written account of findings prepared for a stated reader
the extent to which every required item has actually been recorded
the study of the distribution and determinants of disease in populations
any characteristic that may take different values from one case to another
items.s: Completeness: the extent to which every required item has actually been recorded. The other options describe Report, Epidemiology, Variable.

items.q: Variable may be defined as
o: a rate calculated for the entire population without allowance for its composition
any characteristic that may take different values from one case to another
the number of new cases arising in a population during a stated period
the numerical description of health, disease and health care in a defined population
items.s: Variable: any characteristic that may take different values from one case to another. The other options describe Crude rate, Health statistics, Incidence rate.

items.q: Mortality rate may be defined as
o: a rate calculated for the entire population without allowance for its composition
the study of the distribution and determinants of disease in populations
the number of deaths occurring in a population over a stated period
the register that records every cancer case with its site and outcome
items.s: Mortality rate: the number of deaths occurring in a population over a stated period. The other options describe Crude rate, Cancer registry, Epidemiology.

items.q: The statement “the standard scheme for naming and coding the operations that are performed” describes which of the following?
o: Therapeutic procedure
Principal procedure
Procedure classification
Diagnostic procedure
items.s: Procedure classification is the standard scheme for naming and coding the operations that are performed.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Average length of stay?
o: a system that waits for hospitals to send in their own cases
the mean number of days that patients spend in hospital
the log of all operations performed in each operating theatre
the signed record that a patient agreed to a named procedure
items.s: Average length of stay: the mean number of days that patients spend in hospital. The other options describe Consent form, Passive registration, Theatre register.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Data quality.
o: the number of deaths occurring in a population over a stated period
the register that records every cancer case with its site and outcome

the degree to which recorded information is fit for its intended use
items.s: Data quality: the degree to which recorded information is fit for its intended use. The other options describe Active registration, Cancer registry, Mortality rate.

items.q: The statement “the number of existing cases present in a population at a stated time” describes which of the following?

Incidence rate
Mortality rate
items.s: Prevalence rate is the number of existing cases present in a population at a stated time.
